Its truthful per-step state, owner-addition ledger, physical recovery audit and dependency plan live in `campaigns/packages-2026-09/LIFECYCLE-EXTENSIONS-IMPLEMENTATION-LEDGER.md`. Parallel work has begun on the schema-first six-carrier compiler IR wire (`codex/r6-ir-wire`), R7.2 CLI agent/output contract (`codex/r7-agent-cli`) and R8 artifact/mechanism grammar (`codex/r8-mechanism-grammar`). Root retains architecture, diff acceptance, commits and gates.

facts.WAL-C-PHASE-BOUNDARY: Dependency materialisation is `install`; portable production is `package`; user, client, remote and system reconciliation is `deploy`. `clean` never silently undeploys.
facts.WAL-C-ALGORITHMIC-BASELINE: VibeVM remains fully useful without an LLM. Paid enhancement is explicit per feature (`off | assist | required`), lazily binds a provider and cannot replace the subsystem's algorithmic mode. An explicitly selected agent handler is itself the requested advanced action and fails honestly when neither provider nor host exists.
facts.WAL-C-IR-CARDINALITY: Source/document execute per addressed document; Documents gathers once; closure/lane/ emitted execute per complete final artifact. One JTD epoch with six discriminated carriers is pulled before R3.4 and is shared by trace and the R6 pass ABI.
facts.WAL-C-VERIFIER: The verifier is immutable and manager-owned. Use/Source contract-only cycles follow their existing per-relation law; Embed is acyclic; a union cycle is not automatically a recursive cycle. R3 enables only in tests; R6 enables the same seam for every plugin pass, with no manifest off switch.
facts.WAL-C-MECHANISMS: Scheduled extensions answer when; sibling qualified mechanism providers answer how. Selection is exact target pin → host route → builtin default → hard failure. Builtins are replaceable providers, never hidden branches.
facts.WAL-C-DEPLOY: Deploy uses named target profiles, explicit scope/effects, plan, durable intent, independent verify and strict receipt. Static skill, Agent Plugin, Cargo, client projections, `~/.vibe/bin`, custom installers and future system package providers share this artifact/mechanism plane.
facts.WAL-C-WORKER-HANDOFF: Claudez and Opus are trusted with normal machine tools. A writing worker's handoff remains a visible unstaged diff plus report; it does not add/commit/stash/branch/ reset/push or hide product state. Root reviews and integrates.

facts.WAL-C-GATES: Development uses exact affected tests. The full 47-step panel runs only at coherent batch boundaries on the final unchanged tree, with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4` and Git Bash on this Windows host.
facts.WAL-C-JTD: Every machine JSON/ABI/report starts from JTD + registry + corpus + codegen. Never touch `formats/EPOCHS.toml` or hand-edit generated Rust.
facts.WAL-C-FILES: Authored changed/new files stay at or below 600 physical lines; split by domain seam before the gate.
facts.WAL-C-SCAN: `vibe progress scan` writes campaign state. Debt measurement uses `judging-debt.py`; the current `text-stability.py` hash recipe is stale and must be repaired before its per-fact output is trusted.

Then accept/repair and integrate the four active implementation worktrees in dependency order. The full remaining sequence is in the implementation ledger; no wave or owner addition is dropped merely because the in-memory plan is compacted.
